name: Kimi to Boku to Eden no Ringo
original_name: キミとボクとエデンの林檎
source:
One winter day as he was walking home after school, Ryuusei was suddenly pushed into a black car. Inside he meet his cousin Runa who looks just like him for the first time in 3 years. Runa is the heiress of the wealthy Kaburaki family and attends the prestigious Shirotae Girls’ School and is highly respected by all students. She had been chosen to be the ‘prince’ in the upcoming play, but she lost her voice and wanted him to take her place. Will he taste the fruits of love in this forbidden garden?

This will be the last game by the ORBIT group (ROOT, CLOVER, ALMA) since they will be on hiatus indefinitely after its release due to the effects of the March earthquake and tsunami.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/06/01/june-2011-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
一个冬日，流星放学回家时突然被推进一辆黑色汽车。在车内，他见到三年未见的表妹琉奈，她与自己长得一模一样。琉奈是富有的镝木家继承人，就读于名门白妙女子学园，深受全体学生敬仰。她获选在即将上演的戏剧中扮演“王子”，却失去了声音，希望流星代替自己登台。他能在这座禁忌花园中品尝爱情的果实吗？

本作将是ORBIT旗下团队ROOT、CLOVER和ALMA的最后一部游戏。受三月地震和海啸影响，作品发售后团队将无限期停止活动。

[摘自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2011/06/01/june-2011-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
